W.note: Pleasant violet-to-pink gradient with a sheen and a lift, but the unclipped sheen pseudo-element leaves a visible white smear to the left of the Start free trial button at rest, and the letter-spacing animation on hover adds reflow.

X.note: Most practical of the four, with a legible cream-and-ink label, separate rest/hover/focus/pressed/disabled specimens, a reduced-motion path that keeps the colour change, and a contrast readout; the hover glow is quiet, so the dreamlike quality is more restrained.

Y.note: The dark starfield page suits the brief, with a warm-cream face, a sheen plus glow tail, transform-only motion, a custom curve editor with a live SVG preview, a contrast check and a clean phone layout; the hover crop missed the hovered hero button, so the evidence for its motion is thin.

Z.note: Motes, an aura and a sheen cross make it the most literally dreamy, and the phone layout is tidy, but overflow hidden clips the aura, the motes loop while hovered, the hover crop misses the button, and an empty progress track under the hero looks unfinished.
